full_model_check_runner:
import hashlib,json,subprocess,sys
from pathlib import Path
root=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
sys.path.insert(0,str(root))
from serve.server import child_env
cfg=json.loads((root/'build-local/glm-refill-check-profile.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
exe=root/'build-local/glm5next-candidate-cuda/bin/strata-glm5next-mtp-check.exe'
command=[str(exe),'--model',cfg['args'][1],'--memory-percent','95',
 '--reference','docs/GLM53/GLM53_FLASH_SYNC_REPEAT.json',
 '--reference-logits','build-local/glm-sync-iq3-repeat.f32','--baseline-only','1',
 '--report','build-local/glm-refill-logits.json']
print('Checking saved F32 logits, early host refill on...',flush=True)
with (root/'build-local/glm-refill-logits.log').open('w',encoding='utf-8') as log:
 subprocess.run(command,cwd=root,env=child_env(cfg),stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,check=True)
p=root/'build-local/glm-refill-logits.json'
r=json.loads(p.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
assert r['status']=='pass' and r['baseline_vs_saved_logits']['bit_exact']
r.update(command=command,binary_sha256=hashlib.sha256(exe.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),env=cfg['env'])
p.write_text(json.dumps(r,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
print('F32 exact; checking native pipe lifecycle...',flush=True)
subprocess.run([sys.executable,'tools/check_glm5next_engine.py','--profile','build-local/glm-refill-check-profile.json',
 '--reference','docs/GLM53/GLM53_FLASH_SYNC_REPEAT.json','--output','build-local/glm-refill-pipe.json'],cwd=root,check=True)
print('Native pipe checks passed.',flush=True)
